title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #3 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does Kama mean? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. Good and healthy wishes such as joy and friendship
   C. War
   D. Cruelty

2. What does Dharma mean? (1 mark)
   A. The right way of living
   B. A festival
   C. A sport
   D. A river

3. How should we treat others who hold different beliefs about death? (1 mark)
   A. Argue
   B. Ignore them
   C. Laugh
   D. Listen with respect

4. Which Purushartha is about doing our duty and living rightly? (1 mark)
   A. Artha
   B. Kama
   C. Moksha
   D. Dharma

5. Which is a kind of prayer? (1 mark)
   A. A song of prayer called a bhajan
   B. A market
   C. A race
   D. A school race

6. Which is an act of Prani Daya? (1 mark)
   A. Throwing stones at a dog
   B. Giving water to a thirsty animal
   C. Wasting food
   D. Breaking plants

7. How can we help a friend who uses a wheelchair at a festival? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh
   B. Help them to move safely and include them
   C. Leave them alone
   D. Ignore them

8. Which of these is NOT true about the flag? (1 mark)
   A. It is a national symbol
   B. It may touch the ground
   C. It is raised at ceremonies
   D. It should be respected

9. What is Paryushan Parva mainly about? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer, self-control and forgiveness
   B. Wealth
   C. Feasts only
   D. Racing

10. Which teaching of Paryushan do children practise when they forgive a friend? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Anger
   C. Revenge
   D. Forgiveness

11. Which mistake is common about Madaraka Day? (1 mark)
   A. Knowing the flag is raised
   B. Knowing it is 1 June
   C. Knowing it is for patriots
   D. Thinking it is Independence Day

12. Paryushan Parva is a festival of which faith? (1 mark)
   A. Buddhism
   B. Sikhism
   C. Jainism
   D. Hinduism

13. What is the Indian name for Thursday? (1 mark)
   A. Shukravaar
   B. Guruvaar
   C. Shanivaar
   D. Ravivaar

14. Which is a memory trick for the seven names? (1 mark)
   A. Writing them once
   B. Reading backwards only
   C. Making a rhyme or song
   D. Skipping them

15. Som is another name for which heavenly body? (1 mark)
   A. Saturn
   B. The Moon
   C. The Sun
   D. Jupiter

16. Which day is linked with Venus? (1 mark)
   A. Monday
   B. Sunday
   C. Wednesday
   D. Friday

17. Mangal is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Mars
   B. Venus
   C. Mercury
   D. Jupiter

18. What is the Indian name for Tuesday? (1 mark)
   A. Mangalvaar
   B. Somvaar
   C. Ravivaar
   D. Shukravaar

19. What is the Indian name for Wednesday? (1 mark)
   A. Shanivaar
   B. Somvaar
   C. Budhvaar
   D. Guruvaar

20. Guru (Brihaspati) is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Jupiter
   B. Mars
   C. Venus
   D. Saturn

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. List the five principles of Dharma studied in the lesson. (2 marks)

22. Write the seven days of the week in the Indian traditional calendar with their heavenly bodies. (4 marks)

23. Explain what Maha Shivratri teaches. (4 marks)

24. Explain how the story of Prahlad shows faith in Paramatma. (3 marks)

25. Explain how a school can make festivals inclusive. (4 marks)

26. Describe the story of King Shibi and the dove and give its lesson. (4 marks)

27. Describe what the Panchang is. (2 marks)

28. Explain why forgiveness is important, using Paryushan Parva. (4 marks)

29. Describe how Paryushan Parva is celebrated. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Good and healthy wishes such as joy and friendship
   Kama is good and healthy desire.

2. A — The right way of living
   Dharma includes duty, honesty and kindness.

3. D — Listen with respect
   Respect for others is a value.

4. D — Dharma
   Dharma is right living.

5. A — A song of prayer called a bhajan
   Bhajans are sung prayers.

6. B — Giving water to a thirsty animal
   Kindness to living beings.

7. B — Help them to move safely and include them
   Inclusion is important.

8. B — It may touch the ground
   The flag should never touch the ground.

9. A — Prayer, self-control and forgiveness
   These are its main themes.

10. D — Forgiveness
   Paryushan teaches saying sorry and forgiving.

11. D — Thinking it is Independence Day
   Independence is 12 December.

12. C — Jainism
   It is the main Jain festival.

13. B — Guruvaar
   Guru is Jupiter.

14. C — Making a rhyme or song
   Songs help us remember.

15. B — The Moon
   Som is the Moon.

16. D — Friday
   Shukravaar.

17. A — Mars
   Mangal is Mars, the red planet.

18. A — Mangalvaar
   Mangal is Mars.

19. C — Budhvaar
   Budh is Mercury.

20. A — Jupiter
   Guru is Jupiter.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Paramatma, Purushartha, Prani Daya, Punarjanam, Prarthana (any correct set earns marks).
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each, rounded up.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ravivaar: Sun; Somvaar: Moon; Mangalvaar: Mars; Budhvaar: Mercury; Guruvaar: Jupiter; Shukravaar: Venus; Shanivaar: Saturn.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for every two correct pairs, up to 4.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: Self-control through fasting, faith through prayer, staying alert to do good, and thinking about our mistakes and trying to be better.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Prahlad believed God is everywhere, kept praying when his father was angry, and was protected.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Give clear instructions, help learners with special needs to take part, share food and clothes with the needy, and invite all faiths and communities.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: A frightened dove flew into the king's lap and a hawk demanded it. The king offered his own flesh to save the dove. The lesson is that a kind person protects the weak.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the dove, 1 mark for the hawk, 1 mark for the offer, 1 mark for the lesson.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Indian traditional calendar book that lists days, months and festival dates.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for two points.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Forgiveness removes anger, mends friendships and brings peace. On the last day Jains ask everyone for forgiveness with Micchami Dukkadam.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jains fast, pray and meditate, listen to scriptures such as the Kalpasutra, practise Ahimsa, give to the needy and ask for forgiveness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct practice, up to 3.
